stem: It was my grandmother ____ taught me how to cook traditional dishes.
hint: 正是我奶奶教我做傳統料理。
options: who
which
what
where
ex: 強調句 It was + 人 + who/that + V；被強調的是人，用 who 或 that。
dist: what 本身含先行詞，不能接在被強調部分之後。
where 用於地點，且強調句不用 where。

stem: It is in the library ____ most students prepare for their exams.
hint: 大多數學生正是在圖書館準備考試。
options: that
which
what
when
ex: 強調介系詞片語 in the library，連接詞一律用 that；拿掉 It is…that 句子仍完整。
dist: 強調的是地點，不是時間，且應用 that。

stem: It was not until the storm ended ____ the farmers could check their crops.
hint: 直到暴風雨結束，農夫們才能檢查作物。
options: that
when
did
then
ex: It was not until + 時間 + that + S + V；固定用 that，後面用直述語序。
dist: It was not until…後應接 that，不用 when。
did 是 Not until 句首倒裝的寫法，與強調句混用。
then 不能引導強調句的後半部。

stem: It is because we cooperate ____ succeed.
hint: 正是因為我們合作才能成功。
options: that we can
can we
so we can
which we can
ex: 強調 because 子句：It is because…that + S + V，that 後不倒裝。
dist: 強調句混倒裝；倒裝要用 Only because…can we。
because 與 so 不可並用，也缺 that。

stem: It was ____ the mayor announced the new recycling policy.
hint: 市長正是在記者會上宣布新回收政策。
options: at the press conference that
the press conference that
at the press conference which
the press conference which
ex: 被強調的是介系詞片語 at the press conference，要保留 at，再接 that。
dist: 漏掉介系詞 at，拿掉 It was…that 後句子不完整。
漏 at 又誤用 which。

stem: It was the noise from the construction site, not the heat, ____ kept the residents awake all night.
hint: 讓居民整夜睡不著的，是工地噪音而不是炎熱。
options: that
what
it
and
ex: 強調主詞 the noise…, not the heat，後接 that + V；that 在此兼作主詞。
dist: what 含先行詞，不能接在被強調名詞後。
it 是代名詞，無法連接兩個子句。
and 不能引導強調句後半，句子結構錯。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: It was Kevin who found the lost wallet in the classroom.
It was Kevin which found the lost wallet in the classroom.
It was Kevin what found the lost wallet in the classroom.
It was Kevin he found the lost wallet in the classroom.
ex: 強調人用 who／that：It was + Kevin + who + found…。
dist: 缺連接詞，he 多餘，形成兩個子句。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: It is only through hard work that we can achieve our goals.
It is only through hard work can we achieve our goals.
It is only through hard work which we can achieve our goals.
Only through hard work we can achieve our goals.
ex: 強調句 It is only through… that + S + V 不倒裝；若改句首 Only 才倒裝。
dist: 強調句混倒裝：應 that we can。
Only + 副詞片語置句首須倒裝 can we。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: It was in 2020 that the café first opened its doors.
It was in 2020 which the café first opened its doors.
It was 2020 in that the café first opened its doors.
It was in 2020 when did the café first open its doors.
ex: 強調時間介片 in 2020：It was in 2020 that + S + V。
dist: 介系詞 in 位置錯誤，應放在 2020 前。
when 不用於強調句，且 did 倒裝錯誤。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: It is what you do, not what you say, that shows who you really are.
It is what you do, not what you say, shows who you really are.
It is what you do, not what you say, and shows who you really are.
It is what do you do, not what do you say, that shows who you really are.
ex: 被強調的是名詞子句 what you do，後接 that + V。
dist: 漏 that，句中出現兩個動詞而無連接。
and 不能取代強調句的 that。
名詞子句要直述語序，不可加 do。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: It was the lack of sleep that made him fall asleep in class.
It was the lack of sleep that made him to fall asleep in class.
It was the lack of sleep made him fall asleep in class.
It was because the lack of sleep that made him fall asleep in class.
ex: It was + 名詞 + that + V；make sb + 原形 V。
dist: make sb to V 錯，使役動詞後接原形。
漏 that，is 與 made 兩個動詞無連接。
because 後接子句，接名詞須 because of，且 that 後缺主詞。

stem: 正是社群媒體改變了年輕人取得新聞的方式。
options: It is social media that has changed the way young people get news.
It is social media has changed the way young people get news.
It is social media which it has changed the way young people get news.
It is social media that has changed the way how young people get news.
ex: It is + 主詞 + that + V；the way 後不可再接 how。
dist: 漏 that，兩個動詞無連接。
which 後又多一個 it 作主詞。
the way how 錯，擇一使用。

stem: 正是因為志工的協助，這場淨灘活動才能順利完成。
options: It was because of the volunteers' help that the beach cleanup could be completed smoothly.
It was because of the volunteers' help could the beach cleanup be completed smoothly.
It was because the volunteers' help that the beach cleanup could be completed smoothly.
It was because of the volunteers' help which the beach cleanup could be completed smoothly.
ex: 強調原因片語 because of + N，後接 that + 直述句。
dist: 強調句混倒裝，that 後不倒裝。
because 後須接子句，接名詞要用 because of。

stem: 直到疫情爆發，許多公司才開始允許員工在家工作。
options: It was not until the pandemic broke out that many companies began to allow employees to work from home.
It was not until the pandemic broke out did many companies begin to allow employees to work from home.
It was until the pandemic broke out that many companies began to allow employees to work from home.
Not until the pandemic broke out many companies began to allow employees to work from home.
ex: 直到…才：It was not until + 子句 + that + S + V。
dist: 強調句混倒裝，應 that many companies began。
漏 not，意思變成「一直到…」。
Not until 置句首主要子句須倒裝 did…begin。

stem: 正是照顧我祖父的那位護理師的耐心，讓我決定成為護理師。
options: It was the patience of the nurse who cared for my grandfather that made me decide to become a nurse.
It was the patience of the nurse who cared for my grandfather made me decide to become a nurse.
It was the patience of the nurse who cared for my grandfather that made me to decide to become a nurse.
It was the patience of the nurse which cared for my grandfather that made me decide to become a nurse.
ex: It was + 名詞（含關係子句）+ that + V；make sb V。
dist: make sb to V 錯，應接原形。
nurse 是人，關代不可用 which。

stem: The more you practice, ____ you will become.
hint: 越練習就會越有自信。
options: the more confident
more confident
the most confident
the more confidently
ex: The 比較級…, the 比較級…；become 後接形容詞。
dist: 須用比較級，不是最高級。
become 是連綴動詞，接形容詞不接副詞。

stem: The ____ we leave, the less traffic we will run into.
hint: 越早出發，遇到的車潮越少。
options: earlier
early
more early
earliest
ex: The + 比較級 + S + V；early 的比較級是 earlier。
dist: early 比較級為 earlier，不加 more。
句型用比較級，不用最高級。

stem: The higher the temperature rises, ____ electricity people use.
hint: 氣溫越高，人們用電越多。
options: the more
more
the most
the much
ex: 後半句也要 the + 比較級；more 修飾不可數名詞 electricity。
dist: 句型要比較級，不用最高級。
much 是原級，須改比較級 more。

stem: The ____ you read, the wider your vocabulary will grow.
hint: 書讀得越多，字彙量就越廣。
options: more books
more of books
many books
most books
ex: 比較級與所修飾名詞一起前移：The more books you read。
dist: more 直接修飾名詞，不加 of。
須用比較級，不用最高級。

stem: The more people recycle, ____ waste will end up in landfills.
hint: 越多人回收，進掩埋場的垃圾越少。
options: the less
the fewer
less
the least
ex: waste 為不可數名詞，比較級用 less；後半句要有 the。
dist: 須用比較級，不用最高級。

stem: The more widely the vaccine is used, ____ the virus can spread.
hint: 疫苗越普及，病毒越不容易傳播。
options: the less easily
the less easy
the easier
less easily
ex: 修飾動詞 spread 須用副詞比較級：the less easily。
dist: easy 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 spread。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The longer you wait, the harder it becomes to apologize.
The longer you wait, harder it becomes to apologize.
Longer you wait, the harder it becomes to apologize.
The long you wait, the harder it becomes to apologize.
ex: 越…越…：前後兩半都要 the + 比較級，缺一不可。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The more time teenagers spend online, the less they sleep.
The more time teenagers spend online, less they sleep.
More time teenagers spend online, the less they sleep.
The more time do teenagers spend online, the less they sleep.
ex: The more + N + S + V, the less + S + V；兩半皆直述語序。
dist: 前半句不可加 do 倒裝。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The more trees we plant, the cleaner the air will be.
The more trees we plant, the air will be cleaner.
The many trees we plant, the cleaner the air will be.
The more trees we plant, the cleaner will the air be.
ex: 後半句 the + 比較級移到句首，再接 S + V 直述語序。
dist: 後半句比較級沒有移到前面。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The more convenient public transportation becomes, the more easily people can get around the city.
The more convenient public transportation becomes, the most easily people can get around the city.
The more convenient public transportation becomes, the more easy people can get around the city.
The more convenient public transportation becomes, more easily people can get around the city.
ex: The + 比較級…, the + 比較級…；修飾動詞 get around 用副詞 the more easily。
dist: 此句型兩邊都用 the + 比較級，不可用最高級 most。
easy 比較級為 easier，且修飾動詞應用副詞。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The more carefully you check your answers, the fewer mistakes you will make.
The more careful you check your answers, the fewer mistakes you will make.
The more carefully you check your answers, the fewer you will make mistakes.
The more carefully you check your answers, you will make the fewer mistakes.
ex: 修飾 check 用副詞 carefully；fewer 與 mistakes 一起前移。
dist: careful 是形容詞，不能修飾動詞 check。
fewer 與所修飾名詞 mistakes 被拆開。
後半句比較級沒有移到前面。

stem: 你越常運動，身體就會越健康。
options: The more often you exercise, the healthier you will be.
The more often you exercise, healthier you will be.
The more often you exercise, the more healthily you will be.
The often you exercise more, the healthier you will be.
ex: The 比較級 + S + V, the 比較級 + S + V；be 後接形容詞。
dist: be 動詞後接形容詞，不接副詞。
比較級 more often 須整個移到 the 後。

stem: 城市越擁擠，房價就越高。
options: The more crowded a city is, the higher its housing prices are.
More crowded a city is, the higher its housing prices are.
The more crowded a city is, the more high its housing prices are.
The more crowded a city is, its housing prices are the higher.
ex: The more crowded + S + is, the higher + S + are。
dist: 後半句比較級未移到句首。

stem: 我們越依賴手機，就越難專心讀書。
options: The more we depend on our phones, the harder it is for us to concentrate on studying.
The more we depend on our phones, the harder we are to concentrate on studying.
The more we depend on our phones, the hard it is for us to concentrate on studying.
The more we depend on our phones, it is the harder for us to concentrate on studying.
ex: 難易形容詞用虛主詞：the harder it is for us to V。
dist: hard 不以人當主詞表「難以做」。
後半句比較級未移到句首。

stem: 參加的人越多，活動的氣氛就越熱烈。
options: The more people take part in the event, the livelier its atmosphere becomes.
More people take part in the event, the livelier its atmosphere becomes.
The more take part people in the event, the livelier its atmosphere becomes.
The more people take part in the event, its atmosphere becomes the livelier.
ex: The more + N + V, the + 比較級 + S + V。
dist: more 與名詞 people 被拆開，語序錯。
後半句比較級未移到句首。

stem: For me, walking to school is more relaxing than ____ the crowded bus.
options: taking
take
to take
taken
ex: 比較對等：walking 對 taking，兩邊皆動名詞。
dist: 原形動詞與 walking 不對等。
不定詞與動名詞 walking 不對等。

stem: Many students prefer to study in groups rather than ____ alone.
options: study
studied
to studying
studies
ex: prefer to V rather than V：rather than 後接原形，與 to study 對等。
dist: 第三人稱單數形式不對等。

stem: The population of Taipei is larger than ____ of Tainan.
options: that
those
it
one
ex: 比較對象要同類：the population of A vs that of B；單數用 that。
dist: it 不能接 of 片語代替前述名詞。
one 不用於代替不可數／集合概念且不接 of。

stem: Learning to listen is just as important as ____ to speak.
options: learning
learn
learned
to learning
ex: as…as 前後對等：Learning 對 learning。
dist: 原形與 Learning 不對等。
過去式不能作比較對象。

stem: The prices of fruit this year are higher than ____ last year.
options: those
that
them
it
ex: 代替複數 prices 用 those，比較對象同類。
dist: them 是受格代名詞，不能這樣代替。
it 為單數且不能這樣代替。

stem: Saving energy at home is no less important than ____ new green technology.
hint: 在家節能和研發綠色科技一樣重要。
options: developing
develop
developed
to developing
ex: 比較對等：Saving 對 developing。
dist: 原形與 Saving 不對等。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: For some people, apologizing is harder than making excuses.
For some people, apologizing is harder than make excuses.
For some people, apologizing is harder than made excuses.
For some people, apologize is harder than making excuses.
ex: 比較兩邊同形式：apologizing 對 making。
dist: than 後原形不對等（右丞曾錯）。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The weather in Taichung is milder than that in Taipei.
The weather in Taichung is milder than Taipei.
The weather in Taichung is milder than those in Taipei.
The weather in Taichung is more milder than that in Taipei.
ex: 天氣對天氣：than that in Taipei。
dist: 拿天氣和城市比，對象不同類。
milder 已是比較級，不加 more。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: She chose to take the train rather than drive to the concert.
She chose to take the train rather than drove to the concert.
She chose to take the train rather than to driving to the concert.
She chose to take the train rather than drives to the concert.
ex: to take…rather than drive，rather than 後原形與 take 對等。
dist: 過去式與 take 不對等。
第三人稱單數形式不對等。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The salary of a nurse is often lower than that of a doctor.
The salary of a nurse is often lower than a doctor.
The salary of a nurse is often lower than those of a doctor.
The salary of a nurse is often lower than it of a doctor.
ex: 薪水對薪水：that of a doctor。
dist: 拿薪水和醫生比，對象不同類。
it 不能接 of 片語代替。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: Reading the original novel is more rewarding than watching the movie version.
Reading the original novel is more rewarding than to watch the movie version.
Read the original novel is more rewarding than watching the movie version.
Reading the original novel is more rewarding than the movie version watching.
ex: 動名詞主詞對動名詞：Reading 對 watching。
dist: 不定詞與 Reading 不對等。
語序錯，受詞不可在 V-ing 前。

stem: 與其抱怨，我們應該想辦法解決問題。
options: Rather than complaining, we should find ways to solve the problem.
Rather than complained, we should find ways to solve the problem.
Rather than to complaining, we should find ways to solve the problem.
Rather complaining than, we should find ways to solve the problem.
ex: Rather than + V-ing 置句首，表「與其…」。
dist: 過去式不能接在 rather than 後。

stem: 這支新手機的電池續航力比舊款的長。
options: The battery life of the new phone is longer than that of the old model.
The battery life of the new phone is longer than those of the old model.
The battery life of the new phone is more longer than that of the old model.
The battery life of the new phone is longer than it of the old model.
ex: 比較對象同類：battery life 對 that of the old model。
dist: battery life 單數，不用 those。
longer 已是比較級，不加 more。
it 不能接 of 片語代替。

stem: 對青少年來說，和朋友面對面聊天比在網路上傳訊息更有意義。
options: For teenagers, chatting with friends face to face is more meaningful than sending messages online.
For teenagers, chatting with friends face to face is more meaningful than send messages online.
For teenagers, chatting with friends face to face is more meaningful than to send messages online.
For teenagers, chatting with friends face to face is more meaningful than sent messages online.
ex: 比較兩邊皆動名詞：chatting 對 sending。
dist: 不定詞與 chatting 不對等。

stem: 這座城市的空氣品質已經比十年前好得多。
options: The air quality in this city is much better than it was ten years ago.
The air quality in this city is much better than that was ten years ago.
The air quality in this city is very better than it was ten years ago.
The air quality in this city is much better than it is ten years ago.
ex: 比較現在與過去：than it was ten years ago；比較級用 much 修飾。
dist: that 不可作此處主詞代替 the air quality。
ten years ago 須用過去式 was。

stem: If I had set an alarm, I ____ late for yesterday's interview.
options: would not have been
would not be
will not be
had not been
ex: 與過去事實相反：If had p.p., S + would have p.p.。
dist: would be 用於與現在事實相反。
will 為直說法，不能表假設。
主要子句不用 had p.p.。

stem: If she ____ harder, she would have passed the driving test.
options: had practiced
practiced
would have practiced
has practiced
ex: If 子句用 had p.p.，主要子句 would have p.p.。
dist: 過去式用於與現在事實相反。
If 子句不可用 would have。

stem: We could have saved a lot of money if we ____ the tickets earlier.
options: had booked
book
would have booked
have booked
ex: 主要子句 could have p.p.，If 子句配 had p.p.。
dist: If 子句不可用 would have。

stem: If the government had acted sooner, the flood damage ____ .
hint: 政府若早點行動，水災損失就能減少。
options: could have been reduced
could have reduced
could be reduced
could reduced
ex: 損失「被」減少：could have been p.p.（被動）。
dist: 損失是被減少，應用被動。
could be 是與現在相反，時間不符。

stem: ____ the warning signs, they would not have gotten lost.
hint: 要是他們當時注意到警告標誌，就不會迷路了。
options: Had they noticed
If they noticed
Had they notice
Did they notice
ex: 省略 if 倒裝：Had + S + p.p.。
dist: 過去式只表與現在相反。
與過去相反不能用 Did 倒裝。

stem: If he had not missed the bus this morning, he ____ in class now.
hint: 混合假設：過去沒錯過，現在就會在教室。
options: would be sitting
would have sat
will be sitting
had been sitting
ex: 混合假設：If had p.p.（過去），主要子句 now 用 would + V。
dist: now 表現在，不用 would have p.p.。
主要子句不用 had p.p.。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: If it had not rained, we would have gone camping.
If it had not rained, we would have went camping.
If it would not have rained, we would have gone camping.
If it had not rained, we would gone camping.
ex: If had p.p., would have + p.p.（gone）。
dist: have 後接 p.p.，不是過去式 went。
If 子句不可用 would have。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: If the bus had not broken down, we would have arrived on time.
If the bus had not broken down, we would arrived on time.
If the bus had not broken down, we would have arrive on time.
If the bus did not break down, we would have arrived on time.
ex: would + have + p.p.：would have arrived。
dist: would 後接原形，漏 have（右丞曾錯）。
If 子句須用 had p.p.。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: Had I known about the traffic jam, I would have taken the MRT.
Had I knew about the traffic jam, I would have taken the MRT.
Did I know about the traffic jam, I would have taken the MRT.
Had I known about the traffic jam, I would have took the MRT.
ex: 倒裝 Had + S + p.p., S + would have p.p.。
dist: 與過去相反不用 Did 倒裝。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: The accident might have been avoided if the driver had slowed down.
The accident might have avoided if the driver had slowed down.
The accident might be avoided if the driver had slowed down.
The accident might have been avoided if the driver would slow down.
ex: 意外「被」避免：might have been p.p.；If 子句 had p.p.。
dist: 應用被動 have been avoided。
might be 表現在，時間不符。

stem: 選出文法正確的句子
options: Without your help, I could never have finished the project on time.
Without your help, I could never have finish the project on time.
